selection: Fixed tau2=max(mean_gene(delta2-v),0), v=capture variance/n summed across fit stages. All mapped unique genes including zeros; no feature/sign/grid selection. One-step horizon ratio1.
scope: Capture-balanced log-gene-mean MSE diagnostic, not actual DE/direction/MMD/CSS metrics. Previously exposed targets are development evidence only. No independent embryo inference or benchmark reward. Fit support requires2captures/stage; unsupported cases explicitly unavailable. Allfoldforecasts frozen before targets.
decoder: No cell forecast decoder in this audit; separate predeclaration required before full-panel testing.
resources: D-only disk; memmap genechunks256, twoBLASthreads; no RAM cache
